_comment: E-ink tags (MindReset Dot. Quote/0, 296x152 black and white), drawn and sent by dot_service (scripts/ctl dot). Hot-reloaded. Each tag shows its room's mode, Auto and what is playing; when nothing plays, the quiet line: a scheduler variable of the room's group (rooms schedule API), with quoted: true taking the first 'quoted' phrase from it. link = where a phone tap goes (via the Dot. App / App Clip). The Dot. API key is in ~/.config/screen-machine/dot.json, never here.
